text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: serving-runtime pool (eu-west-1) high restart rate x12 in 5m. Affected pods: serving-runtime-*-gpu, modelcache-daemonset. Node pressure: ephemeral-storage eviction events.

kevin_sre: I'm on it. grabbing logs and kube events now.

maria_prod: seeing repeated OOM and CUDA init failures in the runtime logs, but also journal and tmpfs filling up quickly. modelcache writes large checkpoints to /var/tmp/modelcache and to journal. Suspect log/checkpoint churn -> eviction cascade.

kevin_sre: can you paste the kube events and a sample pod log?

maria_prod: here's truncated k8s event snippet:

```
Events:
  Type     Reason                  Age   From               Message
  ----     ------                  ----  ----               -------
  Warning  DiskPressure            2m    kubelet, node-17   Node node-17 status is now: DiskPressure
  Normal   Evicting                2m    kubelet, node-17   Force evicting pod serving-runtime-abc-123
  Warning  Evicted                 2m    kubelet, node-17   Pod serving-runtime-abc-123 evicted: The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.
```

Sample runtime log tail (errors):

```
E 2024-11-02T12:04:01Z cuda: init failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
E 2024-11-02T12:04:02Z modelcache: checkpoint write failed: no space left on device
E 2024-11-02T12:04:03Z runtime: fatal: unable to allocate kv-cache for seq 512
```

kevin_sre: thanks. Also ran `du -sh /var/tmp/*` on node-17, modelcache folders are 28G total, journalctl usage 14G. Node emptyDir size is default and tmpfs mount for cache is saturating.

dmitri_infra: quick mitigation plan: 1) Scale down background checkpointing for modelcache, 2) rotate/truncate logs on node, 3) cordon & drain node-17 and move serving pods to other capacity, 4) apply a temporary taint to prevent scheduling heavy loads back onto the node. Also suggest fallback to cpu-backed model variant for failed requests until capacity stabilizes.

sarah_ops: I'm executing drain now on node-17 (graceful, with max 120s).

```
# cordon + drain
kubectl cordon node-17
kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=120
```

sarah_ops: drain in progress. evicted 8/12 pods, 4 failing to terminate cleanly (modelcache pinned files).

julia_support: customer-impact check: monitoring shows error spikes for customers c-17, c-24, c-42 on eu-west inference endpoints — ~5-12% failed inferences and latency up to 8s. No broad data exfiltration, only availability. Raising SEV-2.

kevin_sre: taking ownership of the incident; handing on-call to dmitri_infra for infra-level actions after I finish triage notes. dmitri, can you confirm safe rollback for checkpoint config?

dmitri_infra: yes. Pushing a runtime-config override via k/v store to reduce checkpoint frequency and switch to smaller in-memory checkpointing for 1 hour. Command: `rdctl config set modelcache.checkpoint_freq 00:30:00 --ttl 1h` (simulated). Also increasing ephemeral-storage eviction threshold is not feasible without node-level disk ops.

maria_prod: implemented log rotation for modelcache logs (compressed rotation, keep 2 files). Patch applied to DaemonSet. snippet:

```
logrotate /var/tmp/modelcache/*.log {
  daily
  rotate 2
  compress
  copytruncate
}
```

sarah_ops: freed 20G by truncating old checkpoints and rotating journal. `sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=1G` ran successfully. Node free space now 32G.

kevin_sre: runtime restarts subsided to 0-1 per 5m window. CUDA errors no longer seen in latest tail.

julia_support: notifying affected customers via status page: posted incident update with mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution (we will do a controlled restart of modelcache DaemonSet tonight to ensure stable checkpointing).

oncall_scheduler: handoff note: kevin -> dmitri. dmitri is primary. kevin will remain available for follow-ups.

dmitri_infra: next actions (owner: dmitri_infra): 1) schedule rolling restart of modelcache DS to clear stale file locks, 2) add liveness probe to detect blob stall, 3) propose change to mount sizes for tmpfs in next infra sprint, 4) create runbook entry for journal flood & modelcache evictions.

kevin_sre: summary for postmortem: root cause = modelcache checkpoint + verbose logs writing into node tmpfs + systemd journal growth -> ephemeral-storage pressure -> kubelet eviction -> pod restarts -> some pods unrecoverable leading to CUDA init failures. Contributing factor: no quota on modelcache per-node write size and no automated log rotation. Customer impact: transient failed inferences for subset of eu-west customers (SEV-2).

maria_prod: adding immediate follow-ups to product backlog: 1) make checkpointing stream to persistent object store instead of local tmpfs, 2) add per-process ephemeral write quotas, 3) produce cost/latency tradeoff for CPU fallback variant.

sarah_ops: leaving the channel — will watch the rollout. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated, owner -> dmitri_infra, severity -> SEV-2.

dmitri_infra: will own postmortem and runbook update. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
